name: Bolt
aliases: Bolt — Bypass expensive BVH query for exterior voxels
Bolt: Skip expensive BVH queries for exterior voxels
Bypass expensive BVH query for exterior voxels
definition: An optimization for solid voxelization that skips the expensive Boundary Volume Hierarchy (BVH) distance query for voxels determined to be exterior to the mesh, assigning them a placeholder infinite distance instead.
summary: Bolt is a solid voxelization optimization that skips expensive BVH distance queries for exterior voxels by assigning a dummy positive distance, thereby avoiding redundant geometric calculations.
